items.excerpt: A Stanford team's Nature paper introduces Paper2Agent, an automated framework that converts research papers into interactive AI agents, turning static publications into active systems readers can query.
For Peer Review Week 2026 the Chefs name uncomfortable truths about review capacity, with AI writing assistants swelling submissions and reviewers quietly using AI despite few journal policies.
A guest post argues scholarly publishing debates AI governance on stage while staff quietly use AI to get work done, and asks what incentive structures keep the industry from adapting.
Audio and AI lead Frankfurt 2026's program, including an 'AI Narration Beyond the Lab' debate with Storytel, Blinkist and Hörbuch Hamburg on where synthetic narration works and listener acceptance.
Clarivate's Pulse of the Library 2026 finds a widening gap between libraries actively implementing AI and those still experimenting; 16% globally report moderate-to-active AI implementation.

items.title: Turn Your Book Into an Audiobook in Minutes with Spotify for Authors
items.excerpt: Spotify expanded its ElevenLabs-powered Audiobook Creation Tools beyond beta to all US self-published authors: upload a manuscript, pick an AI narration voice, and publish a free, non-exclusive audiobook in minutes.

items.title: Feeling overwhelmed by the AI doom loop? Here's the essential reading list to make sense of it all
items.excerpt: Guardian reporters and experts recommend the books that explain how the AI industry got here and where it is headed, amid a chaotic moment reshaping our lives.
